easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Halo Fountain do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
